page_title: WER 0-2 AUG | Werder Bremen v Augsburg 19/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+4' Issa Kabore (Werder Bremen) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
90+3' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
90+1' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
88' Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
87' Finn Dahmen leaps to intercept the corner kick from Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen).
87' Jess Thorup decides to make a substitution. Henri Koudossou will be replaced by Marius Wolf (Augsburg).
85' Issa Kabore (Werder Bremen) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Werder Bremen.

83' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. He hits the ball poorly and sends it into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
82' That's the end of the game for Marco Grull, who is replaced by Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen).
81' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
81' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
78' A lofted cross from Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
78' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
77' Today's match ends for Alexis Claude-Maurice who will be replaced by Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg).

76' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Werder Bremen are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

75' What an opportunity! Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
74' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Benjamin Brand blows for a foul. Werder Bremen will take a free kick.
73' A pass from Issa Kabore (Werder Bremen) is intercepted by Finn Dahmen and the move breaks down.
72' Substitution. Derrick Kohn will be replaced by Issa Kabore (Werder Bremen).
72' Ole Werner has decided to make a change. Julian Malatini (Werder Bremen) replaces Niklas Stark.
71' The game has come to an end for Marvin Ducksch. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
71' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Benjamin Brand ignores the protests.
70' The Werder Bremen players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
69' The free kick is delivered by Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

67' The ball rebounds out to Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
66' Mert Komur (Augsburg) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

66' Mert Komur (Augsburg) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) replaces Jeffrey Gouweleeuw.
65' We are about to witness a substitution. Mert Komur (Augsburg) is replacing Arne Maier.
65' Jess Thorup has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) replacing Samuel Essende.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Skelly Alvero (Werder Bremen) is coming onto the pitch as Leonardo Bittencourt cannot continue after picking up an injury.

63' This was a piece of cake for Michael Zetterer. Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) found himself some space after latching on to a pass, but his strike only went low to the middle of the goal and into the gloves of the prepared keeper.
63' Great teamplay by Werder Bremen as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
59' Henri Koudossou (Augsburg) gets into a promising shooting position on the edge of the box after a nice pass, but his effort is deflected onto the post by one of the defenders.
57' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
55' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) latches onto a pass and lets fly at goal from the edge of the box. The shot beats the keeper but smashes against the left post. Good effort!

54' The Augsburg players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The linesman signals a throw-in for Werder Bremen.
49' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
48' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
48' Werder Bremen control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' The Werder Bremen players can’t believe it after referee Benjamin Brand signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
45+5' Referee Benjamin Brand makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Werder Bremen. Let’s see what happens!
45+5' Surely that's handball by one of the Augsburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
45+1' 0 - 2 Samuel Essende (Augsburg) scores from a quite difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the left post. Excellent finish.
45+1' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
45' Surely that's handball by one of the Augsburg players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!

44' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
43' Big moment in the game as the red card awarded to Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) is cancelled following the VAR review!

40' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg), but referee Benjamin Brand must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
39' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) receives a red card after his awful challenge. He completely lost his temper and referee Benjamin Brand sends him off the pitch.
34' Arne Maier (Augsburg) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
32' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
32' It seemed like Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
31' Arne Maier (Augsburg) is penalised for holding. Benjamin Brand signals a set piece. That's a free kick to Werder Bremen.
30' Werder Bremen are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
27' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

27' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Good work from Werder Bremen as they win a corner.
26' Werder Bremen seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
24' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) is flagged for offside.
20' The referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
20' Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) scores a goal, but Benjamin Brand makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether the goal can stand.
20' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Anthony Jung (Werder Bremen) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
18' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Werder Bremen.
16' The percentage of ball possession is – 61:39.
13' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

13' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the left side of the goal, but Finn Dahmen is equal to it and makes an easy save. Werder Bremen have a corner.
10' Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
8' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Henri Koudossou (Augsburg).
5' 0 - 1 Samuel Essende (Augsburg) unleashes a ferocious shot from just outside the penalty area and the ball goes into the left side of the goal!
4' Neat passing move from Werder Bremen in order to create new attacking opportunities.
2' Rough tackle by Arne Maier (Augsburg). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Werder Bremen will take a free kick near the side line.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Augsburg will have the kick-off.
